worldcover.name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
worldcover.nativeResolution: 1/12000 degree; nominal 10 m, native pixels vary with latitude
worldcover.access: Public HTTP range windows; no login; object URLs derived from documented distribution, not probed live
worldcover.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
worldcover.redistribution: Allowed with attribution, licence and indication of changes
worldcover.limitations: 2021 classification, not surveyed objects or field boundaries; grassland is not necessarily pasture; wetland class is herbaceous; water class is not detailed hydrology; global overall accuracy 76.7%, not pilot accuracy.

dk-marker.name: Marker 2024 (declared agricultural fields)
dk-marker.nativeResolution: Vector polygons; positional accuracy not confirmed
dk-marker.access: WFS GetCapabilities, DescribeFeatureType, bounded GetFeature in EPSG:25832; do not fetch national ZIP. Endpoint documented, live feature response untested.
dk-marker.license: CC0 1.0 reported by fiboa and openlanddata; direct official metadata not accessible in this session
dk-marker.redistribution: Conditional: confirm official layer-specific CC0 statement before public redistribution
dk-marker.limitations: Declared fields, not cadastral parcels; omit all farm, ownership, requester, financial and crop attributes; year differs from 2021 baseline.

no-ar5.name: FKB-AR5
no-ar5.coverage: Norway; some areas including above tree line unclassified
no-ar5.nativeResolution: Detailed vector land resources, scale 1:1000 and up; not fixed pixel resolution
no-ar5.redistribution: RESTRICTED; NIBIO explicitly limits download to entitled Geovekst/Norge digitalt users. Do not acquire or publish without rights.
no-ar5.limitations: Land-resource polygons are not crop-year parcel boundaries; AR5 is not required for pilot.

no-ar50.name: Arealressurskart AR50
no-ar50.nativeResolution: Generalized vector at 1:50,000, not field boundaries
no-ar50.access: WFS GetCapabilities, then bounded layer BBOX; verify layer and licence before export. No request made.
no-ar50.license: NLOD 1.0 for password-free NIBIO data per provider download policy
no-ar50.redistribution: Verify specific distribution is freely downloadable; attribute NIBIO
no-ar50.limitations: Generalized class polygons may miss small fields and wetlands; optional regional cross-check, not local parcel source.

acquisitionStatus: Publisher documentation inspected; actual source windows and WFS responses not acquired (local DNS blocked). No geographic output is shipped.

outputContract.purpose: Standalone GIS interchange, not browser runtime schema
outputContract.raster: Single-band uint8 GeoTIFF, projected Nordic LAEA metres, north-up; native class codes retained; 255 means unknown/unavailable, valid zero preserved for CLMS
outputContract.vectors: RFC 7946 GeoJSON in WGS84 lon/lat, clipped to actual projected pilot; geometry only
outputContract.rasterBounds: Exact existing D02 region boundaries, no halos; later tile conversion at shared 3.84 km grid
outputContract.classificationPolicy: Keep separate thematic layers, source dates, and unknowns; never infer individual trees, crops, pasture use or surveyed parcels from generic cover pixels.
